_comment: Real, untrimmed response captured 2026-09-12 via GET https://developers.lotto.pl/api/open/v1/lotteries/draw-results/by-date-per-game?gameType=Lotto&drawDate=2026-09-10&index=1&size=10&sort=drawDate&order=DESC with a valid secret header. Unlike the unofficial lotto.pl endpoint (lottopl-response.json), each game is its own items[] entry: Lotto and LottoPlus share drawSystemId/drawDate but are separate DrawResultsGrouped items, each with a single-game results[]. A date with no draw returns HTTP 404.
